name: Richard Qu
intro: Gameplay and software engineer. Combat systems, editor tooling, and full-stack software — with every project labeled hand-coded or AI-assisted.
bio: I’m a Master of Engineering student in Game Design, Development & Innovation at Duke University, with a B.A. in Computer Science from NYU and minors in Game Design and Japanese.
interests: I like making things that combine systems, atmosphere, and emotion. I often start from a technical problem, but what really interests me is how the final experience feels to the player.
